title: Zesty Crispy Peruvian Challots Rocoto Relleno
description: A kid-friendly Peruvian dish featuring crispy challots and herbal flavors, served in a comal vessel, inspired by the traditional rocoto relleno.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, mix together the flour, cornstarch, salt, black pepper, paprika, and garlic powder.
Dip each chopped challot into the flour mixture, then the egg, and finally the flour mixture again.
Double-fry the challots by frying them at 350 degrees Fahrenheit for 2 minutes, then increasing the heat to 375 degrees Fahrenheit and frying for an additional 2 minutes.
Drain the fried challots on paper towels.
Serve the crispy challots in a comal vessel, garnished with chopped fresh herbs.
Prepare the rocoto relleno filling by mixing together chopped fresh herbs, such as parsley and cilantro, with a squeeze of lime juice.
Fill the comal vessel with the rocoto relleno filling and top with the crispy challots.
